decided_by: Agent session for Alexander Kell (epic #880 report v2 data, owner approval 2026-11-11); review in the pull request decides
rationale: AD-361 adds the package archkeel.report with the Python oracle producer of the report v2 payload. The contract gets the component COMP-REPORT (no requires, no public names: no other component imports it yet), and the root layout lists archkeel.report. Two budgets rise because of the new code only. calls_unresolved rises from 988 to 1002: the producer decodes JSON values and fills dicts of lists, and the analyzer leaves calls such as by_component[pair].append, read_text on argparse values and raw.startswith on narrowed JSON values without a proven target; the simple ones were rewritten (typed locals, constants, no literal lookups). typing_positions rises from 58 to 62: four object annotations at the JSON boundary of records.py, where the decoder narrows each value with isinstance.
